en.intro: A private way to ask for support. No account or personal details required.
en.reviewDraft: Demonstration only. Translations await native-speaker and practitioner review.
en.demo: Synthetic adult scenarios · No real service providers
en.exitNote: Quick exit clears this app’s view and session. It cannot erase browser history, screenshots or device monitoring.
en.privacyText: Only authorised participants can read requests. Messages are short-lived; hosting backups may retain deleted data longer. Anonymous entry does not make a monitored device safe.
en.urgentText: This demo does not contact real services or dispatch help. No locally approved emergency contacts are configured. In a real service, use the partner’s validated immediate-support pathway.
en.error: Action not confirmed. Check the connection and refresh before retrying.
en.conflict: This record changed. Review the latest version before continuing.
en.offline: Offline. Nothing will be sent automatically.
en.preferences: How would you like to communicate?
en.languageNote: Interface language does not confirm a provider’s language capability.
en.contactNote: In-app messages only. No calls, SMS or email will be sent.
en.ackNote: Acknowledgement means staff have accepted the request for review. It does not mean care has been delivered.
en.keyNote: Keep this code private. Anyone holding it can access your active request. The reception reference cannot open messages.
en.messageNote: Avoid names, contact details and medical history. Messages clear when the request closes.
en.noReferrals: No referral proposed. Your current support remains available.
en.consentNote: Approval applies only to this recipient, these fields and this expiry. Your source conversation is not shared. Declining does not stop existing support.
en.cancelNote: Cancellation blocks future platform access. Information already viewed or copied cannot be recalled.
en.refAckNote: Recipient acknowledgement is not a guaranteed appointment, bed or emergency response.
en.noMatch: No confirmed option matches. Ask authorised staff to review alternatives; nothing has been forwarded.
en.stale: Stale details — not a confident recommendation
en.language_unconfirmed: Requested language not confirmed by provider
en.closeWarning: Completing this request deletes its private messages. Record required clinical information only in the partner’s authorised system.
en.simulation: Demo simulation: no external SMS, calls or email.
en.receptionNote: Reception can route requests but cannot read private conversations.
en.idle: This shared session will clear soon.
en.sentNote: A request is sent only after the server confirms it.
en.unsent: Not sent. Show this general choice to staff, then clear the screen.
en.overDue: Acknowledgement overdue. Review options; never forward automatically.
en.consentScope: Only the selected fields below will reach this recipient.
en.mfaNote: Use an authenticator app. Keep setup keys private.
en.label: Label
en.previewNote: Changes remain private until reviewed and published.
en.assignedOnly: Practitioners can read assigned requests only. Revoking membership blocks subsequent access.
en.metricsNote: Synthetic demonstration counts. Small groups and current-day reports are withheld. These are not measures of clinical benefit.
en.pausedClinicNote: Clinic created with access paused. Provision an administrator and review all configuration before opening.
en.demoStartNote: Demo: starting a request prepares the two fictional providers for two hours. No real healthcare capacity is implied.
en.providerNeedsRefresh: This provider is not currently confirmed as accepting requests. In this synthetic demo, prepare the providers and try again.

nd.intro: Indlela eyimfihlo yokucela usizo. Akudingeki i-akhawunti kumbe imininingwane yakho.
nd.reviewDraft: Isibonelo kuphela. Ukuhumutsha kulindele ukuhlolwa ngabezilimi labachwepheshe.
nd.exitNote: Ukuphuma kusula isikrini lesikhathi salolu hlelo. Akusuli imbali yesiphequluli, izithombe kumbe ukuqapha idivayisi.
nd.privacyText: Abavunyelweyo kuphela bangafunda izicelo. Imiyalezo ihlala isikhathi esifitshane; amakhophi angagcina okususiweyo isikhathi eside. Ukungatsho ibizo akuvikeli idivayisi eqashiweyo.
nd.urgentText: Isibonelo asixhumani lezinsizakalo zangempela kumbe ukuthumela usizo. Akulamafoni aphuthumayo aqinisekisiweyo. Ensizakalweni yangempela landela indlela evunyelwe ngumlingani.
nd.error: Isenzo asiqinisekiswanga. Hlola ukuxhumana uphinde ulayitshe ungakazami futhi.
nd.conflict: Irekhodi liguqukile. Hlola elisanda kufika ungakaqhubeki.
nd.contactNote: Imiyalezo yalolu hlelo kuphela. Akulamafoni, SMS kumbe imeyili ezathunyelwa.
nd.ackNote: Ukwamukela kutsho ukuthi abasebenzi bazahlola isicelo. Akutsho ukuthi usizo seluphiwe.
nd.keyNote: Gcina ikhodi iyimfihlo. Olayo angavula isicelo sakho. Inombolo yokwamukela ayivuli imiyalezo.
nd.messageNote: Ungafaki amabizo, imininingwane yokuxhumana lembali yezempilo. Imiyalezo iyasulwa isicelo sivalwa.
nd.consentNote: Imvumo ngeyalo mamukeli, lezi zinkambu lalesi sikhathi kuphela. Ingxoxo yokuqala ayabiwa. Ukwala akumisi usizo lwamanje.
nd.cancelNote: Ukusula kuvimba ukufinyelela okulandelayo. Ulwazi oselubonwe kumbe olukopiweyo alubuyiseki.
nd.refAckNote: Ukwamukela akuqinisekisi i-aphoyintimenti, umbhede kumbe usizo oluphuthumayo.
nd.noMatch: Akulandlela eqinisekisiweyo. Cela abasebenzi bahlole ezinye; akulalutho oludlulisiweyo.
nd.closeWarning: Ukuqeda isicelo kusula imiyalezo. Gcina ulwazi oludingekayo ohlelweni lomlingani oluvunyelweyo kuphela.
nd.simulation: Isibonelo: akula SMS, amafoni kumbe imeyili yangaphandle.
nd.receptionNote: Abokwamukela bangadlulisela izicelo kodwa abakwazi ukufunda ingxoxo eyimfihlo.
nd.sentNote: Isicelo sithunyelwe kuphela uma iseva isiqinisekisile.
nd.unsent: Akuthunyelwanga. Tshengisa lokhu kubasebenzi ususule isikrini.
nd.overDue: Ukwamukela kulibele. Hlola ezinye indlela; ungadluliseli ngokwakho.
nd.mfaNote: Sebenzisa uhlelo lokuqinisekisa. Gcina okhiye beyimfihlo.
nd.label: Ibizo
nd.assignedOnly: Ochwepheshe bafunda izicelo abazinikiweyo kuphela. Ukususa imvumo kuvimba ukufinyelela.
nd.metricsNote: Amanani esibonelo. Amaqembu amancane lemibiko yanamuhla iyafihlwa. Akusilinganiselo senzuzo yezempilo.
nd.demoPathway: Ukudluliselwa kulolu hlelo kuphela — umhlinzeki wesibonelo
nd.pausedClinicNote: Ikliniki idaliwe imisiwe. Nika umphathi uhlole izilungiselelo ungakavuli.
nd.demoStartNote: Idemo: ukuqala isicelo kulungiselela abahlinzeki ababili abaqanjiweyo okwamahola amabili. Lokhu akutsho ukuthi usizo lwempilo lwangempela luyatholakala.
nd.providerNeedsRefresh: Akukaqinisekiswa ukuthi umhlinzeki wamukela izicelo khathesi. Kule demo, lungiselela abahlinzeki uzame futhi.

zu.intro: Indlela yangasese yokucela usizo. Akudingeki i-akhawunti noma imininingwane yakho.
zu.reviewDraft: Umboniso kuphela. Ukuhumusha kusalinde ukubuyekezwa izikhulumi zolimi nabasebenzi.
zu.demo: Izibonelo zabantu abadala · Abekho abahlinzeki bangempela
zu.exitNote: Ukuphuma kusula isikrini neseshini yalolu hlelo. Akusuli umlando wesiphequluli, izithombe noma ukuqashwa kwedivayisi.
zu.privacyText: Abagunyaziwe kuphela bangafunda izicelo. Imiyalezo igcinwa isikhashana; amakhophi angagcina okususiwe isikhathi eside. Ukungasho igama akuyenzi iphephe idivayisi eqashwayo.
zu.urgentText: Lo mboniso awuxhumani nezinsizakalo zangempela noma uthumele usizo. Azikho izinombolo eziphuthumayo eziqinisekisiwe. Enkonzweni yangempela landela indlela egunyazwe umlingani.
zu.error: Isenzo asiqinisekisiwe. Hlola uxhumano bese uvuselela ngaphambi kokuphinda uzame.
zu.conflict: Leli rekhodi lishintshile. Buyekeza elakamuva ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
zu.contactNote: Imiyalezo yalolu hlelo kuphela. Akukho zingcingo, SMS noma i-imeyili ezothunyelwa.
zu.ackNote: Ukwamukela kusho ukuthi abasebenzi bazohlola isicelo. Akusho ukuthi usizo selunikeziwe.
zu.keyNote: Gcina le khodi iyimfihlo. Onayo angavula isicelo sakho. Inombolo yokwamukela ayivuli imiyalezo.
zu.messageNote: Ungafaki amagama, imininingwane yokuxhumana nomlando wezempilo. Imiyalezo iyasuswa uma isicelo sivalwa.
zu.noReferrals: Akukho kudluliselwa okuhlongozwayo. Usizo lwamanje lusaqhubeka.
zu.consentNote: Imvume ingeyalo mamukeli, lezi zinkambu nalesi sikhathi kuphela. Ingxoxo yokuqala ayabelwana ngayo. Ukwenqaba akumisi usizo lwamanje.
zu.cancelNote: Ukukhansela kuvimba ukufinyelela okulandelayo. Ulwazi olubukiwe noma olukopishiwe alubuyiseki.
zu.refAckNote: Ukwamukela akuqinisekisi i-aphoyintimenti, umbhede noma usizo oluphuthumayo.
zu.noMatch: Ayikho indlela eqinisekisiwe. Cela abasebenzi babuyekeze ezinye; akukho okudlulisiwe.
zu.closeWarning: Ukuqedela isicelo kususa imiyalezo. Gcina ulwazi oludingekayo ohlelweni lomlingani olugunyaziwe kuphela.
zu.simulation: Umboniso: akukho SMS, izingcingo noma i-imeyili yangaphandle.
zu.receptionNote: Abokwamukela bangadlulisela izicelo kodwa abakwazi ukufunda ingxoxo yangasese.
zu.sentNote: Isicelo sithunyelwa kuphela uma iseva isiqinisekisile.
zu.unsent: Akuthunyelwe. Bonisa lokhu kubasebenzi bese usula isikrini.
zu.overDue: Ukwamukela sekwephuzile. Buyekeza ezinye izindlela; ungadluliseli ngokuzenzakalelayo.
zu.mfaNote: Sebenzisa uhlelo lokuqinisekisa. Gcina okhiye beyimfihlo.
zu.label: Ilebula
zu.assignedOnly: Ochwepheshe bafunda izicelo ababelwe zona kuphela. Ukuhoxisa ubulungu kuvimba ukufinyelela.
zu.metricsNote: Izibalo zomboniso. Amaqembu amancane nemibiko yanamuhla iyafihlwa. Akusona isilinganiso senzuzo yezempilo.
zu.demoPathway: Ukudluliselwa kulolu hlelo kuphela — umhlinzeki womboniso
zu.pausedClinicNote: Ikliniki idaliwe imisiwe. Yabela umphathi ubuyekeze izilungiselelo ngaphambi kokuvula.
zu.demoStartNote: Idemo: ukuqala isicelo kulungiselela abahlinzeki ababili abaqanjiwe amahora amabili. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kukhona usizo lwezempilo lwangempela.
zu.providerNeedsRefresh: Akuqinisekisiwe ukuthi lo mhlinzeki wamukela izicelo okwamanje. Kule demo, lungiselela abahlinzeki bese uzama futhi.

xh.intro: Indlela yabucala yokucela inkxaso. Akufuneki akhawunti okanye iinkcukacha zakho.
xh.reviewDraft: Umboniso kuphela. Iinguqulelo zilindele ukuhlolwa zizithethi zolwimi neengcali.
xh.demo: Imizekelo yabantu abadala · Akukho baboneleli bokwenene
xh.exitNote: Ukuphuma kususa isikrini neseshoni yale app. Akucimi imbali yesikhangeli, imifanekiso okanye ukubekwa esweni kwesixhobo.
xh.privacyText: Ngabathathi-nxaxheba abagunyazisiweyo kuphela abafunda izicelo. Imiyalezo igcinwa okwexeshana; iikopi zinokugcina idatha ecinyiweyo ixesha elide. Ukungachazi igama akusikhuseli isixhobo esibekwe esweni.
xh.urgentText: Lo mboniso awuqhagamshelani neenkonzo zokwenene okanye uthumele uncedo. Akukho nombolo zingxamisekileyo ziqinisekisiweyo. Kwinkonzo yokwenene landela indlela evunyiweyo liqabane.
xh.error: Isenzo asiqinisekiswanga. Jonga uqhagamshelo uze uhlaziye phambi kokuzama kwakhona.
xh.conflict: Le rekhodi itshintshile. Jonga inguqulelo yamva phambi kokuqhubeka.
xh.offline: Akukho intanethi. Akukho nto iza kuthunyelwa ngokuzenzekelayo.
xh.contactNote: Imiyalezo yale app kuphela. Akukho minxeba, SMS okanye imeyile iza kuthunyelwa.
xh.ackNote: Ukwamkelwa kuthetha ukuba abasebenzi baza kuhlola isicelo. Akuthethi ukuba unyango lunikezelwe.
xh.keyNote: Gcina le khowudi iyimfihlo. Nabani onayo angavula isicelo sakho. Inombolo yolwamkelo ayivuli imiyalezo.
xh.messageNote: Musa ukufaka amagama, iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano nembali yezonyango. Imiyalezo iyacinywa xa isicelo sivalwa.
xh.noReferrals: Akukho kuthunyelwa kucetywayo. Inkxaso yakho yangoku isafumaneka.
xh.consentNote: Imvume yeyalo mamkeli, ezi nkcukacha neli xesha kuphela. Incoko yokuqala ayabelwana ngayo. Ukwala akuphelisi inkxaso ekhoyo.
xh.cancelNote: Ukurhoxisa kuthintela ukufikelela okulandelayo. Ulwazi olubonwe okanye olukotshiweyo alunakubuyiselwa.
xh.refAckNote: Ukwamkelwa akuqinisekisi idinga, ibhedi okanye impendulo engxamisekileyo.
xh.noMatch: Akukho khetho luqinisekisiweyo. Cela abasebenzi bahlole ezinye; akukho nto ithunyelweyo.
xh.closeWarning: Ukugqiba isicelo kucima imiyalezo. Gcina ulwazi olufunekayo kwinkqubo egunyazisiweyo yeqabane kuphela.
xh.simulation: Umboniso: akukho SMS, minxeba okanye imeyile yangaphandle.
xh.receptionNote: Abasewamkelweni bangathumela izicelo kodwa abakwazi ukufunda incoko yabucala.
xh.idle: Le seshoni ekwabelwana ngayo iza kucinywa kungekudala.
xh.sentNote: Isicelo sithunyelwa kuphela xa iseva isiqinisekisile.
xh.unsent: Akuthunyelwanga. Bonisa olu khetho kubasebenzi uze ucime isikrini.
xh.overDue: Ukwamkelwa kulibazisekile. Hlola ezinye iinketho; ungathumeli ngokuzenzekelayo.
xh.consentScope: Ziinkcukacha ezikhethiweyo kuphela eziya kufika kumamkeli.
xh.mfaNote: Sebenzisa i-app yokuqinisekisa. Gcina izitshixo ziyimfihlo.
xh.label: Ileyibhile
xh.assignedOnly: Iingcali zifunda izicelo ezabelweyo kuphela. Ukurhoxisa ubulungu kuthintela ukufikelela.
xh.metricsNote: Amanani omboniso. Amaqela amancinci neengxelo zanamhlanje zifihliwe. Asiyomilinganiselo yenzuzo yezonyango.
xh.demoPathway: Ukuthunyelwa kule app kuphela — umbanelei womzekelo
xh.pausedClinicNote: Ikliniki yenziwe imisiwe. Yabela umlawuli uhlole uqwalaselo phambi kokuvula.
xh.demoStartNote: Idemo: ukuqala isicelo kulungiselela ababoneleli ababini abayintsomi iiyure ezimbini. Oku akuthethi ukuba kukho iinkonzo zempilo zokwenene.
xh.providerNeedsRefresh: Akuqinisekiswanga ukuba lo mboneleli uyazamkela izicelo ngoku. Kule demo, lungiselela ababoneleli uze uzame kwakhona.

af.intro: Vra privaat vir ondersteuning. Geen rekening of persoonlike besonderhede nodig nie.
af.reviewDraft: Slegs demonstrasie. Vertalings wag op hersiening deur moedertaalsprekers en praktisyns.
af.demo: Fiktiewe volwassenes · Geen werklike diensverskaffers nie
af.exitNote: Vinnige uitgang maak hierdie app se aansig en sessie skoon. Dit wis nie blaaiergeskiedenis, skermgrepe of toestelmonitering uit nie.
af.privacyText: Slegs gemagtigde deelnemers kan versoeke lees. Boodskappe is tydelik; rugsteune kan geskrapte data langer hou. Anonieme toegang maak nie ’n gemoniteerde toestel veilig nie.
af.urgentText: Hierdie demo kontak geen werklike dienste en stuur geen hulp nie. Geen plaaslik goedgekeurde noodkontakte is ingestel nie. Gebruik die vennoot se bevestigde noodroete in ’n werklike diens.
af.error: Handeling nie bevestig nie. Gaan die verbinding na en verfris voor jy weer probeer.
af.conflict: Hierdie rekord het verander. Hersien die jongste weergawe voordat jy voortgaan.
af.offline: Vanlyn. Niks sal outomaties gestuur word nie.
af.expired: Verval of nie meer beskikbaar nie
af.languageNote: Koppelvlaktaal bevestig nie ’n verskaffer se taalvermoë nie.
af.contactNote: Slegs boodskappe binne die app. Geen oproepe, SMS’e of e-posse word gestuur nie.
af.ackNote: Erkenning beteken personeel het die versoek vir hersiening aanvaar. Dit beteken nie sorg is gelewer nie.
af.keyNote: Hou hierdie kode privaat. Enigiemand daarmee kan jou aktiewe versoek oopmaak. Die ontvangsverwysing ontsluit nie boodskappe nie.
af.messageNote: Vermy name, kontakbesonderhede en mediese geskiedenis. Boodskappe word skoongemaak wanneer die versoek sluit.
af.noReferrals: Geen verwysing voorgestel nie. Jou huidige ondersteuning bly beskikbaar.
af.consentNote: Goedkeuring geld slegs vir hierdie ontvanger, velde en vervaldatum. Jou oorspronklike gesprek word nie gedeel nie. Afwysing stop nie bestaande ondersteuning nie.
af.cancelNote: Kansellasie blokkeer toekomstige toegang. Inligting wat reeds gesien of gekopieer is, kan nie teruggeroep word nie.
af.sent: Gestuur, wag op erkenning van ontvanger
af.refAckNote: Erkenning waarborg nie ’n afspraak, bed of noodreaksie nie.
af.noMatch: Geen bevestigde opsie pas nie. Vra gemagtigde personeel om alternatiewe te hersien; niks is aangestuur nie.
af.stale: Verouderde besonderhede — geen bevestigde aanbeveling nie
af.language_unconfirmed: Versoekte taal nie deur verskaffer bevestig nie
af.noRequests: Geen versoeke binne jou toegangsregte nie.
af.closeWarning: Voltooiing skrap private boodskappe. Teken vereiste kliniese inligting slegs in die vennoot se gemagtigde stelsel aan.
af.editDisclosure: Wysig konsep en maak goedkeuring ongeldig
af.simulation: Demosimulasie: geen eksterne SMS’e, oproepe of e-posse nie.
af.receptionNote: Ontvangspersoneel kan versoeke stuur, maar nie private gesprekke lees nie.
af.idle: Hierdie gedeelde sessie sal binnekort skoongemaak word.
af.sentNote: ’n Versoek is eers gestuur wanneer die bediener dit bevestig.
af.unsent: Nie gestuur nie. Wys hierdie algemene keuse aan personeel en maak dan die skerm skoon.
af.noData: Nog niks om te wys nie.
af.overDue: Erkenning is agterstallig. Hersien opsies; stuur nooit outomaties aan nie.
af.consentScope: Slegs die gekose velde hieronder bereik hierdie ontvanger.
af.label: Etiket
af.previewNote: Veranderinge bly privaat tot hersiening en publikasie.
af.assignedOnly: Praktisyns lees slegs toegewese versoeke. Herroeping blokkeer verdere toegang.
af.metricsNote: Fiktiewe demotellings. Klein groepe en vandag se verslae word weerhou. Dit meet nie kliniese voordeel nie.
af.suppressed: Weerhou om klein groepe te beskerm
af.demoPathway: Slegs verwysing binne die app — fiktiewe verskaffer
af.pausedClinicNote: Kliniek geskep met toegang onderbreek. Stel ’n administrateur aan en hersien instellings voor opening.
af.demoStartNote: Demo: wanneer jy ’n versoek begin, word die twee fiktiewe diensverskaffers vir twee uur voorberei. Dit dui nie op werklike gesondheidsorgkapasiteit nie.
af.providerNeedsRefresh: Hierdie diensverskaffer is nie tans bevestig as beskikbaar vir versoeke nie. Berei die diensverskaffers in hierdie sintetiese demo voor en probeer weer.
